meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. National statistical system (GSO), population, national accounts, prices, labour, central-bank anchors, and early USA trade/relationship markers. Population ~102.3 million (2025).
meta.usa_note: United States is Vietnam’s largest single export market and a top-two overall trading partner. Bilateral goods trade has grown rapidly (electronics, apparel, furniture, footwear dominant on the Vietnam→US side). Comprehensive Strategic Partnership context; FDI and people-to-people links also rising.

candidates.title: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam (GSO) institutional core
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / National Statistics Office
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, trade and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Organised vertically from central to provincial and district levels.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Vietnamese statistical system.

candidates.title: Population and housing census / mid-year population estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population reached approximately 102.3 million in 2025, ranking third in Southeast Asia. Provides the demographic base for all per-capita and planning indicators; fertility now below replacement.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Viet Nam (GDP)
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a rapidly industrialising, export-oriented economy.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates by major commodity group. High-frequency price signal used in monetary policy and welfare analysis.
referenced_by: State Bank of Vietnam monetary policy

candidates.title: Labour force and employment statistics
candidates.description: Labour-force participation, employment, unemployment and related indicators from household and enterprise surveys. Captures the large manufacturing and services workforce that underpins export performance.

candidates.title: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, external accounts and key macro-financial statistics. Publishes monetary, banking and external-sector data.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam / GSO related
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual BOP statistics. Captures the large goods-trade surplus (especially with the United States) and FDI inflows that characterise Vietnam’s external position.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node with strong goods-export surplus signature.

candidates.title: Vietnam–United States merchandise trade statistics
candidates.description: Bilateral goods trade with the United States. The US is Vietnam’s largest single export market; key categories include electronics/telephones, computers, furniture, apparel and footwear. Trade volumes have expanded rapidly over the past decade.
candidates.notes: High-centrality bilateral trade node. USA is the dominant export destination.

candidates.title: Vietnam–United States Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing
candidates.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and the United States
candidates.description: Political and economic relationship framework elevated to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. Continuously referenced in trade, investment, security and people-to-people cooperation analysis.
referenced_by: Security and South China Sea discussions
candidates.notes: Key bilateral political-economic frame that underpins the large trade relationship.

candidates.title: Vietnam foundational statistical-system and USA-linkage meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO, SBV and bilateral sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the GSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, labour statistics, SBV institutional role, BOP, Vietnam–US merchandise trade and Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing into the opening foundation layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Vietnamese research, with explicit USA trade and partnership edges.
